cards.ex: The company managed to weather the storm of the recession thanks to its loyal customers.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya sodiq mijozlari tufayli inqiroz bo'ronini muvaffaqiyatli yengdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan muvaffaqiyatli o'tmoq, zarar ko'rmasdan omon qolmoq.

cards.ex: Don't expose yourself to unnecessary risks by walking alone at night.
cards.exUz: Kechasi yolg'iz yurib o'zingizni keraksiz xavflarga duchor qilmang.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni xavfli yoki yoqimsiz narsaga duchor qilmoq.

cards.ex: There's always downside risk involved when investing in the stock market.
cards.exUz: Fond bozoriga sarmoya kiritishda har doim yomonlashuv xavfi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning yomonlashishi, salbiy natijalar ehtimoli.

cards.ex: Starting her own business was a leap of faith, but it paid off.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesini boshlash ishonch qadami edi, lekin o'zini oqladi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli bo'lishiga qaramay, ishonch bilan qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: The pandemic will eventually run its course, and things will return to normal.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya oxir-oqibat o'tib ketadi va vaziyat normallashadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir tugagunicha davom etish, xavf yoki muammolarni o'z vaqtida tugatish.

cards.ex: Her career was in jeopardy after the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Janjal chiqqandan keyin uning karyerasi xavf ostida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida, yo'qotish yoki zarar ko'rish ehtimoli yuqori.

cards.ex: Politics can be a minefield of conflicting opinions.
cards.exUz: Siyosat qarama-qarshi fikrlarning xavf manbai bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: The negotiations are on a knife edge; either side could walk away at any moment.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar qil ustida; har ikki tomon istalgan vaqtda ketishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Noaniq va xavfli vaziyatda, natija noma'lum.

cards.ex: Their whole financial empire was a house of cards, waiting to collapse.
cards.exUz: Ularning butun moliyaviy imperiyasi qulashini kutayotgan qog'oz uy edi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan nozik, beqaror tizim.

cards.ex: The politician skirted around the controversial question.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi bahsli savoldan chetlab o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammodan yoki savoldan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob bermasdan qochish.

cards.ex: The rainforest is under threat from deforestation.
cards.exUz: Tropik o'rmonlar daraxt kesilishi tufayli xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida, yo'q bo'lish yoki zarar ko'rish xavfi.

cards.ex: His arrogance was a fatal flaw that ultimately cost him the election.
cards.exUz: Uning takabburligi halokatli xato edi, bu esa oxir-oqibat unga saylovda mag'lubiyatga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Muqarrar ravishda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib keladigan jiddiy kamchilik.

cards.ex: The company ran afoul of environmental regulations and was fined.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish qoidalariga zid keldi va jarimaga tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalar, qonunlar yoki odamlar bilan muammoga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: You're tempting fate by driving so fast in this weather.
cards.exUz: Bu ob-havoda juda tez haydash orqali siz taqdirni sinayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki ahmoqona harakatlar bilan omadni sinash.

cards.ex: Technology is a double-edged sword; it can help us but also harm us.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilich; u bizga yordam berishi ham, zarar etkazishi ham mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ham foyda, ham zarar keltirishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The journey was fraught with danger.
cards.exUz: Sayohat xavfga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf, muammo yoki qiyinchiliklar bilan to'la bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He's courting trouble by skipping work so often.
cards.exUz: U tez-tez ishni tashlab ketishi bilan o'ziga muammo izlayapti.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizga muammo yoki xavf tug'diradigan harakatlar qilmoq.

cards.ex: Balancing work and family life is a high-wire act.
cards.exUz: Ish va oilaviy hayotni muvozanatlash xavfli harakatdir.
cards.uzDef: Katta mahorat va ehtiyotkorlikni talab qiladigan xavfli yoki qiyin vaziyat.

cards.ex: The politician had to run the gauntlet of hostile questions from the press.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi matbuotning dushmanona savollaridan o'tishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'plab qiyinchiliklar yoki tanqidlardan o'tish.

cards.ex: The marketing campaign backfired spectacularly and damaged the company's reputation.
cards.exUz: Marketing kampaniyasi kutilmaganda teskari ta'sir qildi va kompaniya obro'siga zarar etkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki harakat kutilmaganda yomon oqibatlarga olib kelmoq.

cards.ex: The company was on the ropes after losing several major contracts.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bir nechta yirik shartnomalarni yo'qotgandan keyin nokaut holatida edi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolar tufayli mag'lubiyat yoqasida bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He's a slippery customer, so be careful when dealing with him.
cards.exUz: U ishonchsiz odam, shuning uchun u bilan munosabatda bo'lganda ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Ishonch qiyin bo'lgan, hiyla-nayrang ishlatadigan odam.

cards.ex: We need to head off the problem at the pass before it gets out of control.
cards.exUz: Muammo nazoratdan chiqib ketishidan oldin uni to'xtatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon sodir bo'lishidan oldin to'xtatmoq.

cards.ex: The government bailed out the bank because it was considered too big to fail.
cards.exUz: Hukumat bankni qutqardi, chunki u qulay olmaydigan deb hisoblangan.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyot uchun juda muhim bo'lganligi sababli qulay olmaydigan kompaniya yoki tashkilot.

cards.ex: The trade war is becoming a dangerous game of chicken between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Savdo urushi ikki davlat o'rtasida xavfli qo'rqoqlik o'yiniga aylanib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda birinchi bo'lib taslim bo'lmaslikka urinish.

cards.ex: The two companies are on a collision course over intellectual property rights.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya intellektual mulk huquqlari bo'yicha to'qnashuv yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: Nizoga yoki muammoga olib keladigan yo'nalishda.

cards.ex: Cutting social services leaves vulnerable people at risk.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy xizmatlarni qisqartirish zaif odamlarni xavf ostida qoldiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir osonlikcha zarar ko'rishga yoki hujumga duchor qilmoq.

cards.ex: The investigation could open Pandora's box of corruption.
cards.exUz: Tergov korruptsiyaning Pandora qutisini ochishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ko'plab kutilmagan muammolar yoki yomon narsalarni keltirib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: It's time to grasp the nettle and deal with the problem head-on.
cards.exUz: Endi qiyinchilikka dadil kirishib, muammoni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri hal qilish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyat bilan dadil shug'ullanmoq.

cards.ex: Voting for him was the lesser of two evils.
cards.exUz: Unga ovoz berish ikki yomondan yengili edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yoqimsiz variantdan eng kam yomoni.
